_comment: Immutable pin of the IHP model files the benches load. Verified by sim/harness/pdkartifact.py BEFORE any simulator runs (harness.cli run/selftest/verify-pdk, hbt-kaband run.py, sim/characterize.sh, and the 'sim-smoke' CI job). Only the file hashes establish a match; install_marker is provenance. Update procedure: sim/README.md 'IHP model artifact'.

upstream.tag_resolved: 2026-10-09 via GitHub API git/ref/tags/v0.3.0 (lightweight tag -> commit)
upstream.github_archive_note: Observed digest of https://github.com/IHP-GmbH/IHP-Open-PDK/archive/<commit>.tar.gz on 2026-10-09. GitHub does not promise byte-stable generated archives, so it is informational and NOT used for verification; the git commit id plus the per-file hashes below are.

install_marker.note: Provenance only: a marker never establishes a match, and a missing marker is reported as unknown (hashes decide).

closure_note: Dependency closure of cornerHBT.lib (.include/.lib targets, followed transitively) -- all that sim/characterize.sh smoke and selftest load (npn13G2 only; no MOS/OSDI, no passives). harness/pdkartifact.py re-derives the closure from the installed cornerHBT.lib and fails if it differs from this list. Files measured identical between the local install and the pinned commit's tree on 2026-10-09.

ngspice.note: Version the smoke/selftest modes were run against locally (ngspice-46 banner). CI builds exactly this tarball.
